```text
--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 4m02s | run 20261112-194316-hunt-f1eb | 5 confirmed, 0 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3792

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Failed stats request is shown as 'No harvests in this range'
   where: /stats (GET /api/stats/harvests)
   expected: A visible error with a way to retry when the stats request fails
   saw: {"hits":2,"alerts":[],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194316-hunt-f1eb/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "500-shown-as-error-not-empty")
2. MEDIUM From date after To date (via URL) shows empty state instead of the server's reason
   where: /stats?from=2026-10-01&to=2026-02-01
   expected: The 422 message 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' or a similar error is shown
   saw: {"alerts":[],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194316-hunt-f1eb/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "inverted-range-shows-reason")
3. MEDIUM Malformed stats response crashes the page and leaves it stuck on 'Loading stats…'
   where: /stats
   expected: An error message and no uncaught exception
   saw: {"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 2","Tomato"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194316-hunt-f1eb/probes/faults.mjs (expectation "malformed-no-crash")
4. MEDIUM Clearing the To date silently extends the range to the end of the current year
   where: /stats
   expected: An empty To field is refused or treated in a way that makes sense for the chosen range
   saw: {"line":"6 harvests from 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026","fields":[{"label":"From","value":"2025-01-01"},{"label":"To","value":""}]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194316-hunt-f1eb/probes/more.mjs (expectation "cleared-to-not-silently-extended")
5. MEDIUM Hung stats request leaves 'Loading stats…' forever with the old range's data shown
   where: /stats
   expected: A timeout or error after a reasonable wait, and stale results not shown as if they were current
   saw: {"text":["From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194316-hunt-f1eb/probes/more.mjs (expectation "hang-not-stuck-loading")
--- end of rough-ride hunt ---
```
